title: Dat-ecosystem: high level applications built on top of P2P protocols
summary: The Dat ecosystem is a collection of decentralized, peer-to-peer applications built on top of the Dat protocol, enabling serverless, version-controlled data sharing across distributed networks without relying on centralized infrastructure.
problem_solved: Enables decentralized, censorship-resistant data sharing and synchronization without requiring centralized servers or cloud infrastructure.
why_valuable: Provides an alternative to cloud-centric data sharing by enabling users to own and control their data through true P2P networking with built-in versioning and selective sharing capabilities.
